reason: Modelled from SparkFun's v2.0 schematic, hookup guide and the ATtiny84A Qwiic_Quad_Relay firmware (0x01-0x04 toggle, 0x05-0x08 status reads 0x0F/0x00 continuing to relay 4, 0x0A/0x0B/0x0C all off/on/toggle, 0xC7 address); header GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL from the silkscreen, no on-board I2C pull-ups, 7-12 V barrel jack modelled as an external VIN supply. Check PASSED on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
